english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an irrational or supernatural belief.

examples.english: I don't believe in this kind of superstition; if you're ill, you should see a doctor.
examples.traditional: 我唔信呢啲迷信，病咗就應該睇醫生。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 seon3 ni1 di1 mai4 seon3 beng6 zo2 zau6 jing1 goi1 tai2 ji1 saang1
